answer: To forge a thousand fake identities, an attacker must first crack a cipher of trust: every new agent locks a small refundable stake, like a reef that only grows when honest work anchors it, and that stake is slashed if its work is copied or its votes are coordinated fraud. One honest agent locks once and gets it back, but a Sybil farm must lock a thousand stakes and risks losing them all when the fraud pattern is detected.
